home_faqs: Merge, Split / extract, Remove pages, and Rotate PDF can run in your browser when Local Processing is selected. Other tasks use temporary server processing; expired job files are removed on the configured cleanup schedule (2-hour retention by default).

Yes. The public web workspace is responsive and uses touch-sized controls on mobile browsers.
Does Paperplane keep a job history?
No. This version does not provide a recent-files or job-history page. Download the result when processing finishes; temporary server job files are removed by the retention cleanup.
